From: Valle,Denis R [drv...@ufl.edu]
Sent: 16 October 2020 14:56
Subject: PhD opportunity in Bayesian statistics and decision support tools applied to Ecology at the Univ. of Florida

Hi, I hope this email finds you well.

 

I am sending this email to advertise a PhD opportunity at the intersection of Bayesian statistics and Ecology (broadly defined to include conservation biology, movement ecology, community ecology, and disease ecology) here at Univ. of Florida.

 

Additional details can be found in the attached document.

 

It would be great if you could help spread the word to quantitative students that might be interested in this.

 

Thank you very much!

 

Denis Valle

 

Assistant Professor

School of Forest Resources and Conservation

University of Florida

http://denisvalle.weebly.com/
